title: Capacity Fuselet - ad-hoc tally & contact sampler
content:
Purpose: quick ad-hoc tally ("fuselet") to capture short-window capacity deltas, owners to ping, and immediate mitigation options. This is a lightweight tracker for cross-team handoffs during small surges or routing experiments. Not authoritative — use for fast routing/ops calls and then reconcile in the master capacity ledger.

Table snapshot (rows are purposely terse):
Owner | Team | Region | Capacity delta (GPU-hours) | Priority | Contact (Slack) | Quick mitigation notes
Priya Raman | product-ops | us-west1 | +18 | P2 | @priya | Hold non-critical batch reroutes; enable ephemeral burst pool; contact infra-oncall
Tom Chen | infra | us-east1 | -12 | P1 | @tomc | Throttle new model rollouts, scale up queued Dedicated nodes (temp), PR queued: #2345
Aisha Patel | solutions | eu-west1 | +6 | P3 | @aisha | Defer SE demo slots; ask customers for scheduled windows; short GTM notice
Miguel Santos | serving-runtime | ap-southeast1 | -9 | P1 | @miguel | Switch to lower-quant model for short TTL; enable KV prefix caching for top routes
Rohit Kapoor | sre | global | +0.5 | P2 | @rohit | Monitor tail latency; reroute a subset to fallback region if 95p > 450ms

Mini-analysis:
- Net delta across observed windows: +3.5 GPU-hours (small positive but concentrated in us-west1).
- Highest immediate risk: us-east1 and ap-southeast1 (infra and serving-runtime show negative deltas).
- Quick wins: enable ephemeral burst pools in us-west1 to absorb immediate +18; push low-impact traffic to burst pool; lower quantization for ap-southeast1 routes to reduce per-token compute.

Open questions / quick asks:
- Can infra confirm burst pool capacity availability today (Tom)? (ETA: 2h)
- Can SEs/solutions deprioritize scheduled demos in eu-west1 for next 24 hours? (Aisha)
- Can serving-runtime validate model variant compatibility for switching quantization on the impacted route? (Miguel)

Next steps (owner assignments):
- Priya: coordinate cross-team huddle at 09:30 PDT, post summary to #ops-fuselet (action: create follow-up ticket if mitigation extends >24h).
- Tom: validate burst pool + add temporary Dedicated nodes if needed (action: ENG-4821).
- Miguel: run compatibility smoke on quantized variant and report perf delta in channel.
- Aisha: contact customer success for scheduled slot deferral language; compile a one-paragraph GM note if customers ask.
- Rohit: keep latency watch and run the 15-min tail-sample (include 95p/99p).

Notes to self: keep this sheet ephemeral; if repeated pattern emerges, promote to the "capacity-crosswalk" canonical tracker and schedule a retro. Timestamped snapshots appended in the sheet history are the source of truth for reconciliation.

Quick links (context):
- Fuselet pilot plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Fuselet+pilot
- Related infra ticket: ENG-4821
- Runtime PR for burst routing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345
